title: The support of a cone current is invariant under positive dilations
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, ℝ^P = Euclid P) that is a cone (IsConeCurrent C: currentEval(η_{0,λ#}C, ω) = C(ω) for every λ > 0 and every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), where η_{0,λ#}C = blowUp C 0 λ): for every λ > 0 and every v ∈ spt C, also λv ∈ spt C (spt as in Simon 6.2.11, GeometricCurrentOn.support).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ v ∈ C.support, lam • v ∈ C.support
